name: Matched FactorForge v3.3.0 DP Benchmark on the Archived v3.2.0 Corpus
description: This dataset provides a separately executed, matched computational evaluation of the FactorForge v3.3.0 feasibility_best dynamic-programming objective on the 49,257-protein corpus and historical codon-reference policy used by the archived FactorForge v3.2.0 benchmark. It is a cross-version comparison: the DP objective was not part of the historical v3.2.0 execution. The deposit contains a 49,257-row metric-only CSV, aggregate JSON summary, execution and resume provenance, data dictionary, Figure 7 source and rendered artifacts, and supporting benchmark, table, and figure scripts. The source protein FASTA, protein sequences, generated CDS sequences, and codon-reference file are not redistributed. Exact input and software hashes identify the locked execution. All 49,257 records completed without execution error. Reported pass fields are computational predicates. In particular, the legacy raw field biological_pass means sequence-integrity checks only and is not biological or wet-lab validation. Type IIS-clean status does not guarantee cloning or assembly success. The dataset does not demonstrate or guarantee expression, yield, synthesis acceptance, folding, glycosylation, regulatory approval, or biological activity.
